_about: Table, route and job -> target authority classification (roadmap sections 14.1 and 16). First matching rule wins, per repo. 'keep' means it stays with its current repo. A table, route or job no rule matches is reported as UNCLASSIFIED and fails the Wave 0 exit criteria. Table rules with repo 'prod-only' apply to tables found only in production and may name the database file ('db', exact) or a pattern ('dbMatch'). Route rules match the path ('match') and optionally 'method'/'file'; job rules match 'file' and optionally 'name'. Live has no catch-all route or job rule on purpose: a new Live route or job must be classified here.

_dispositions.extract: authority moves to the target service in the named wave; current repo keeps a projection or adapter
_dispositions.frozen-legacy: read-only; already superseded, kept for cutover/migration only (never written)
_dispositions.migrate-then-drop: data migrates to the target, then the table is removed
_dispositions.investigate: no clear owner yet; needs a decision
_dispositions.mirror: a read copy the target authority keeps current; the current repo no longer writes it
_dispositions.staged: a copy held in the target service while the source still writes it (authority not moved yet)
_dispositions.sample: example application data, not platform data
